_note: Mechanisms subsystem (MEC) local numbers, owner D6, revision D6-R2 (2026-11-09; R1 the same day). Read by fusion/mechanisms.py (ctx.local), make_mechanisms.py and team/D6/mech_calcs.py (P:mec.*). Shared numbers (hinge line, chord, elevon spans and travel, fin plane and thickness, VD, torque factor) come from params/params.json and are not repeated. Frame: params.json#frame (x aft, y right, z up, metres). Stations are given for the RIGHT side; the left side is the exact mirror through DP-SYM. Horn and arm outlines are in mm in the hinge frame: X aft from the hinge line, Z up from the hinge axis (upper skin at the hinge).

model.value: Savox SH-0255MG+ (micro, metal gear, aluminium case, 6.0 V)
model.note: one per side drives both panels of that side (params wing.elevon.panels_per_side 2). Fallback EMAX ES3054 (3.5 kgf cm, 17-20 g) only if F4's envelope (CR-F4-12) is accepted as the VD case

case_m.note: L along x, W along z, case height along y (spline boss excluded; listing H 29.4 mm includes it). Measure one servo

ear_span_m.note: tip to tip of the mounting ears along x; measure

ear_y_from_base_m.note: ear plane height from the case base (along y)

shaft_from_aft_end_m.note: output shaft centre from the case end nearest the hinge; shaft on the case mid-width

mass_g.note: listing 15.8 g, distributor sheet 16 g; with its own 150 mm lead; weigh (T-D6-WEIGH)

stall_torque_6v_kgfcm.note: rated stall at 6.0 V; the UBEC rail is 6 V (F1), 5.75 V at the servo with both stalled (CL-F2-SERVO-V)

stall_current_6v_a.note: retailer sheet, 1.2 A at 4.8 V; F1 bench T-F1-SERVO-STALL

throw_deg.note: +/- output angle at 1000 / 2000 us; the linkage needs <= this for +/-25 deg surface (bench T-D6-THROW)

backlash_deg.note: free play at the output spline, metal-gear micro servo, worst new

shaft_x_m.note: servo shaft 54.6 mm ahead of the hinge; case x 0.178-0.201 where the core is 20.4-24.2 mm deep (12 mm servo + >= 6 mm foam above)

shaft_above_skin_m.note: case base flush with the lower skin; shaft on the case mid-width (W/2)

arm_plane_y_m.note: servo arm, pushrod and inboard horn share this plane: straight pushrod along x; 15 mm inboard of the inboard panel end (0.30)

outboard_horn_y_m.note: 15 mm outboard of the outboard panel start (0.34)

r_m.note: 0.61 x horn radius: +/-25 deg surface at about +/-44 deg servo; hole drilled 1.6 mm in the supplied single arm at 15.6 mm

mass_g.note: supplied with the servo; counted here as its own part

r_m.note: clevis pin hole straight below the hinge axis; 16 mm below the lower skin at the hinge so the 4 mm clevis clears the rod boss by >= 1 mm through the travel

bridge_r_m.note: inter-panel rod centre below the hinge axis; feasible band 13.8-18.9 mm in D3's 24 x 12 mm notch; 16.5 centres the sweep

plate_t_m.note: 6 perimeters at 0.4 mm, 100 % infill, PETG; slot cut 2.5 mm through the panel

outline_mm.note: arm below the panel in the hinge frame (X aft, Z up from the hinge axis), closed polygon; the in-panel blade is added from the section

blade_x_mm.note: in-panel blade, skin to skin, aft of the 28 deg bevel

flange_mm.note: lower flange: X from, X to, width along y, thickness; bonded to bare foam (tape cut back). D6-R2: width 20 -> 14 mm (bond area still >= C6 minimum)

backplate_mm.note: upper backplate, 1.5 mm aft of the 25 mm hinge tape; bonded to bare foam. D6-R2: width 16 -> 12 mm

boss_len_m.note: on the face toward the fin; the link rod is bonded over this length (fixed end)

pin_hole_d_m.note: printed 1.4, drilled to the clevis pin

bore_d_m.note: 3.175 mm rod + 0.06 mm epoxy each side

d_m.note: 1/8 in (3.18 mm) pultruded unidirectional CF rod (D6-R2, was 1/8 in music wire: -6.6 g); a 3.0 mm metric rod also fits the 3.3 mm bore (loss 8.3 %)

e_pa.note: longitudinal modulus of pultruded CF rod, low end (makers list 120-140 GPa); T-D6-TWIST measures the lag

steel_gcc.note: music wire / 2-56 steel rod density: used for the pushrod MEC-003

trade_d_e.note: rods considered for MEC-005 (D6-R2 trade, CALC-D6-ROD-TRADE): 3/32 in music wire (A1 D-48 fallback), 2 mm CF rod (A3 suggestion), 1/8 in music wire (R1)

d_m.note: 2-56 threaded-end steel rod (0.072 in); Z-bend at the servo arm, steel 2-56 clevis + silicone keeper at the horn

clevis_mm.note: length from the pin along the rod, width across the jaws (y), height (in the x-z plane), slot depth from the pin; measure the delivered clevis

hole_play_mm.note: diametral play: Z-bend in the arm hole drilled 1.6 mm with a pin vise, clevis pin in the drilled horn hole

e_pa.note: 2-56 steel rod (was read from mec.link.e_pa until D6-R2 made the link CF)

od_id_m.note: roll-wrapped CF tube 5 x 4 mm, one per panel along the panel LE; inboard tube shortened (cover_frac)

x_aft_of_hinge_m.note: front of the tube 1 mm aft of D1's 30 deg bevel line (wing/params.json#elevon.bevel_deg) at the tube's lower edge; tube on the local mid-thickness (cover about 1.5 mm)

g_pa.note: in-plane shear modulus, 0/90 roll-wrapped (low end; +/-45 tubes reach 20 GPa); T-D6-TWIST measures panel twist

fill_g_per_m.note: epoxy + microballoon fill of the routed groove

cover_frac.note: fraction of the drive-to-far-end length the tube covers, [inboard, outboard] panel, measured from the horn. Inboard tube runs 0.150 m inboard of the horn (|y| 0.135-0.295, 160 mm with the 10 mm past the horn): the torque near the far end is small (loss 6.8 -> 7.1 %). Outboard tube kept full length: wing tip, ground handling, tip stiffness

foam_g_pa.note: XPS F-250 shear modulus, mid of 5-12 MPa published range for 25-35 kg/m3 XPS

skin_t_m.note: one layer of packing tape; the panel skin is closed into a torsion box by taping the LE bevel face (BUILD step)

skin_g_eff_pa.note: BOPP G about 1 GPa, 50 % credit for adhesive shear lag and overlaps

clear_m.note: servo case to frame wall, each side

window_rim_m.note: D6-R2: the frame top plate is a 4 mm rim with a window over the servo case (-0.9 g per frame); the case bears on the rim, the bond area stays >= the C6 minimum (CL-D6-BOND-FRAME)

lip_m.note: cover overlap on the frame flange each side

screw.value: M2 x 6 self-tapping, pan head (2 per cover)

width_m.note: one strip per panel on the upper skin, centred on the hinge line

areal_kgm2.note: one layer of 50 um BOPP packing tape with adhesive

fill.note: thin parts print almost solid (perimeters dominate)

clear_min_m.note: minimum gap through full mechanical travel

slop_max_deg.note: surface free play, worst-case sum, new parts

mech_stop_deg.note: mechanical stops 5 deg beyond wing.elevon.deflection_deg: TE down = D1's 30 deg panel bevel on the core TE face (wing/params.json#elevon.bevel_deg), TE up = the arm on the cover slot end

x_m.note: GENERATED by make_mechanisms.py from k09kit.surface_z (subsystems/wing/s5010.dat, chord wing.chord_m)

zu_m.note: GENERATED by make_mechanisms.py from k09kit.surface_z (subsystems/wing/s5010.dat, chord wing.chord_m)

zl_m.note: GENERATED by make_mechanisms.py from k09kit.surface_z (subsystems/wing/s5010.dat, chord wing.chord_m)

mass_total_g.note: GENERATED: sum of the 22 declared part masses (EST until weighed, T-D6-WEIGH)
